chunks: Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn 'Ali ibn Faddal, from 'Abd Allah ibn Bukayr, who said:
A man asked Aba 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, while I was with him, about an intoxicant and nabidh getting onto a garment. He said: "There is no harm in it."

key_terms.الثَّوْبَ: the garment or clothing affected by the substance
key_terms.النَّبِيذِ: nabidh; a drink infusion discussed in legal rulings
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام rule about intoxicant or nabidh getting on a garment?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal ruling from Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام regarding intoxicant and nabidh coming into contact with a garment. The Imam's reply indicates that there is no problem, making the narration relevant to discussions of ritual purity and impurity in fiqh.
